title: Lore Tablet
description:
Take a right when you reach the bottom of the elevator, climb the ledges, and hit a lever to reach it.

_At the seventh bell toll, send:_

_Thirty measures, four beats Smokerock,_

_Eight beats Sweetsmelt,_

_Mark of fealty, all workers._

_At the ninth bell toll, send:_

_Twenty measures, two beats Smokerock,_

_Seven beats Sweetsmelt,_

_Mark of fealty, all workers._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_In the air. The water. Everywhere._

_Inside their shells. Twisted inside. Guts._

_Tightest around heart. Pulsing rhythm._

_Sick. Alive. Dead?_

_Something worse._

_Deeper. Must look deeper._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_-ilgrim_

_You who have held tight to faith have been carried far._

_This station shall offer brief rest to those devout._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Pilgrim_

_This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._

_May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

title: Lore
description:
_Litany of the Worker_

_May we catch the dregs and never tire,_

_May we clean the dregs and never hunger,_

_May we spool the dregs and never falter._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Pilgrim_

_This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._

_May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

title: Lore
description:
_This low, her gaze escaped._

_Prepare, sisters. Weave hope anew._

_That we might break free this accursed web born of our naive foundation._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Pilgrim_

_You are blessed to walk the foundations of Pharloom._

_Humble yourself before the shells of those who gave their lives to hold our kingdom's weight._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Weaver of Pharloom._

_By grace you warded. By thread you healed._

_For your favour, eternal, we offer our song._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_On the eighth harvest, send:_

_Fifty measures, nine beats dregthread, spooled,_

_Fourteen measures dregthread, twined,_

_Oath of fealty, all workers._

_On the twelfth harvest, send:_

_Forty measures dregthread, spooled,_

_Two beats fine thread, twined,_

_Oath of fealty, all workers._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Pilgrim_

_Spare a song for those who lay here silent._

_By strength abandoned they fell before the final ascent._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Pilgrim_

_Accept the judgement of the rise beyond,_

_That all who stand at Pharloom's holy crest prove pure of will and want._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Sister, spider, sat between salt and stone,_

_Build those tools of brilliant mind imagined,_

_Aid us when our Silk has waned._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Use the Needolin to see the final thoughts of Alchemist Zylotol's first assistant.

_The buds must grow..._

_Only a little... Only a spark..._

_To our dead lands... life..._

_Too dark..._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
In a room behind the Breakable Wall

_Bug born of Pharloom. You have been chosen._

_May our Citadel's holy gilding harden your soft shell._

_Stand eternal as our arbiter, that no bug bearing sin shall step within our sacred halls._

title: Confession Stand
description:
Insert 25 Rosaries for lore. On the other side, attack some gears to break the machine and receive different dialogue.

_Speak now. Thy confession will be heard._

_**Hornet:** ..._

_You have confessed a sin most grave and must by works cleanse yourself._

_Return to your task and work off-cycle, neither eating nor supping until new-cycle begins._

_By the grace of Pharloom eternal may you never tire. Toil, and be forgiven._

---

Alternative dialogue if the machine is broken on the other side:

_Speak... ... confession..._

_**Hornet:** ..._

_You... ... sin... ... cleanse..._

_Return... ... work... ... begins...._

_... Pharloom... ... never... ... forgiven._

title: Lore
description:
_Great bugs! You who weep as your kingdom fades, join me upon the Stage._

_Together, we shall enflame the passion of Pharloom!_

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Here is established, by holy consent of the Conductors, The Memorium of Pharloom._

_What Is Remembered Is Never Lost._

title: Lore
description:
_O, great land whose flame doth falter!_

_Whose choir, conductors, all doth fail,_

_Observe! Take heart! That spark still burning,_

_Yon butterfly of crimson grace,_

_All bells shall peal, and voices raise,_

_When brave Trobbio steps, at last, upon the stage!_

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Hate for their light. Hate for their pins. For their waste poured thick and endless._

_Fill your hearts with hate, for power has now been claimed, and with it we shall punish._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Oath of the Whiteward_

_While song must be sung, none may falter._

_Infirmity. Sickness. Death._

_All are banished from our Citadel._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Sister, spider, if seeking commune with the creature atop this mount, take the climb above as a test, a challenge beyond even our setting._

_Upon that summit gained, and creature hailed, know it shall choose what gift to grant, with death as likely as insight._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Their shells are ours. Their souls are ours._

_Our hate is forever._

title: Lore
description:
_Penitent, Eight of the Twelfth._

_Guilty of the sin of irreverence._

_Penance by chaining._

_Absolution granted after death._

_Penitent, Second of the Fourth._

_Guilty of the sin of dissonance._

_Penance by silencing._

_Absolution granted after death._

title: Lore
description:
_Penitent, Fourth of the Fourth._

_Guilty of the sins of infirmity, sickness._

_Penance by swallowing._

_Absolution granted after death._

_Penitent, Twelfth of the First._

_Guilty of an unnamed sin._

_Penance by casting._

_Absolution not granted._

title: Lore
description:
**Note: Will disappear after breaking all of the bindings outside the cell.**

_Penitent, First of the First._

_Guilty of the sin of apostasy._

_Penance by constriction._

_Absolution denied._

title: Lore
description:
At the end of the path beneath the Passage.

_A rune depicting paths away from Pharloom._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Due to unacceptably high injury and unsanctioned deaths, Ventrica travel shall henceforth be denied to all._

_For Pharloom eternal, a bug who serves must never die._

title: Lore
description:
_Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, frail with age._

_Tracked and taken in Sandsea Waste._

_Seven Choristors, nine Envoys lost to task._

title: Lore
description:
_Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, mortally wounded._

_Tracked and taken in the Blackbarrens._

_Four Choristors, one Reed lost to task._

title: Lore
description:
_Weaver, in quarter part, last of their line, staked to service._

_Tracked and taken beneath the City of Steel._

_Eight Choristors, twelve Envoys lost to task._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
_Containment fails. Memory lost. Excise outer. Maintain inner._

_Shellwood stasis sustained - Remember._

_Marrowlands stasis critical - Remember._

_Verdanian environment exceeded - Destined to forget._

title: Riddle Tablet
description:
**Required:** Silk Soar to reach it

**Locations of Herald the Mushroom:**
- Mister Mushroom 1 - "Under chapel fallen to the monarch's might"
- Mister Mushroom 2 - "Over camp collapsed to the black thread plight"
- Mister Mushroom 3 - "Scorched field on edge, shells black and burned"
- Mister Mushroom 4 - "Up towers spinning, near the surgeon spurned"
- Mister Mushroom 5 - "Cage of one who raged against the silken lie"
- Mister Mushroom 6 - "Fell heart of frost, who soars on high"
- Mister Mushroom 7 - "Past cradle's peak, last test of fitness"

title: Needolin Lore
description:
**Required:** Needolin. **Must be read before the Flea Caravan will move here.**

_Sisters, spiders, watch these waters flow,_

_Cleansing Binding, as Silk from shell,_

_Memories of our kingdom calm._

title: Lore
description:
_Coral sways,_

_Clear water flows,_

_Upon our river free of time._

title: Lore
description:
_At water's source,_

_And coral's heart,_

_Our lord born last to rule._

title: Lore
description:
_Flickering Flame_

_Five masks swirled soul, brought and broiled._

_Four stones rage-baked, crushed powder coarse._

_Three shells fresh from pilgrims fallen, to contain and age._

title: Lore
description:
Adds Void Tendrils to the Hunter's Journal.

_A rune-scroll depicting void given form._

title: Lore
description:
_Erase our fear,_ 

_Eliminate our desire,_

_To suffer no more,_

_Void, cleanse us._

title: Lore
description:
_In silence your voice,_

_In darkness your form,_

_We higher who see you seeking,_

_Our shells yearn for your embrace._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Lore revealed by playing Needolin

_Sister, spider, husk bound to branch,_

_Watch over these bugs, passing safe,_

_Warded by fear,_

_No longer your meal._

title: Lore
description:
ACT 3

_Damned are we! The lingered few bound still to suffer. Cursed thrice by Pharloom, to wait, to watch, to cry our anguish._

_No more! We say! No more! We cry! We all have wailed and wept. Fair Pharloom's fall has come at last. Its end we now accept._

title: Lore
description:
In a tunnel above the Lore Tablet, Silk Soar  required.

_Anguished Aura_

_Eight masks hard, swirled soul enraged._

_Twelve aknids flat, all juices strained._

_Six pilgrims living, hung long to drain._

title: Lore Tablet
description:
Inside the building.

_Here we honour the seed that sprung the wood._

_By her grace may all bugs pass safe to join us and our song._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Discovered when playing the Needolin in front of a fountain inside the building.

_...Spirit of the wood..._

_...To seed... To grow..._

_...Health of the heart..._

_...Distant reach... distant life..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for lore.

_...Beauty... faded..._

_...All our glory..._

_...All our wealth..._

_All to end... like this?_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin next to the corpses for some lore.

_...This ceaseless sound..._

_...No more..._

_...Remember... silence..._

_...Remember... peace..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin next to the corpse for some lore.

_Divine Silk..._

_We sang your chains..._

_We prayed a cage..._

_Damned bugs..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Use the Needolin near the construct's head for lore.

_... WE... ALL... TOGETHER..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin next to the lore tablet.
The previous lore tablet will break after.

_Sister, spider, husk bound to moss,_

_Watch over these bugs born low,_

_Raised up by fervour fostered,_

_Born and caught within our web unknowing._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin while standing near the corpses for some lore.

_...All ours..._

_...All your wishes..._

_...All your will..._

_...None beyond..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin while standing near the corpse for some lore.

_...So dark..._

_...None left..._

_...Where now?_

_...Lost... Alone..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for some lore.

_Feared by all..._

_Revered by all..._

_Dear sisters..._

_Must we hide?_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for some lore.

_Why... this pain?_

_To devote... eternal..._

_To serve... beyond shell..._

_...Must we?_

_Please..._

_Remember my voice..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin inside the Chapel of the Architect - specifically in a secret room to the right of the place where you claim the Architect Crest - for some lore.

_Always another..._

_Our hope..._

_Build... Craft... Pass..._

_Can it end?_

_Always eternal..._

_Designs... divine..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin near the corpse for some lore.

_"...Held in our hearts..."_

_"...Harden the path..."_

_"...Remembered..."_

_"...Dear one..."_

_"...Suffer no more..."_

_"...Worthy..."_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Use the Needolin near the construct's head for lore.

_... WE... ALL... TOGETHER..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for some lore.

_...The hunt..._

_...The last..._

_...Pale...prey..._

_...Come to me..._

title: Lore
description:
In Nuu's room. Can only be read after she leaves.

_A scroll detailing the scents and tastes of Pharloom's various bugs and beasts._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin while standing near the Craftmetal for some lore.

_Too tired... Too hungry..._

_In dark, forgotten..._

_Toil no more..._

_Heat... and quiet..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
In the Chapel of the Architect, you can play the Needolin near a construct for some lore.

_...Our existence..._

_...Build... grow..._

_...Our memories... Our record..._

_...Remember..._

_...As it was built..._

_...It shall not end..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin while standing near the pilgrim after his burial for some lore.

_Citadel..._

_Sacred... path..._

_Holy... reward..._

_Pilgrimage..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play Needolin in front of the mirror, found on the first left while climbing the shortcut elevator shaft, for some lore.

_Why us, Sister?_

_She spun us to fade..._

_Why us?_

_She spun us to break..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Use the Needolin in front of the desk where the Snare Setter is found.

_...To bind her... tight..._

_...To keep us free..._

_...Our runes... Our Silk..._

_...Is it done?_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Right at the altar where you get the Ruined Tool.

_Strength enough_

_Strength beyond our silk_

_To build, to hope_

_To keep us free_

title: Lore
description:
Appears after defeating the Palestag and collecting all 17 essences throughout Verdania.

_Two children born entwined, apart,_

_Two children marked to rule,_

_They danced, they sang, proved blades beyond,_

_But none forgot their birth,_

_For lovers born on beat exact shall be forever cursed._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
In a room accessed via Faydown Cloak or Silk Soar after defeating Disgraced Chef Lugoli. 

_For you all..._

_Shells to soak... and define..._


_Pharloom's flavour..._
_Preserved... remembered..._

_This holy taste..._

_From you all..._

_Pharloom's soul..._

_Essence... true essence..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin near a corpse here for some lore.

_The Citadel... the holy Citadel..._

_The climb, so sheer..._

_The gate, so near..._

_Why now, must we fade?_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
In the area above Styx. Silk Soar required to reach it.

_The one to fear..._

_Who is me?_

_The one who serves..._

_My strength or theirs?_

_Who to be?_

_The weak must serve..._

_The one who breeds..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin near the cages at the bottom of the room for some lore.

_...Eternal..._

_That we may pray..._

_Holy Silk..._

_That we may sing..._

_Highest... holy..._

_That we may bow..._

_Your will... your bounty..._

_Your gift... divine..._

_Spun... Served... Sacrificed..._

_By your grace..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin in the room behind the Breakable Wall for some lore.

_Spin... Bind... Punish..._

_Our mother... true..._

_Wake... Wake... Wake..._

_Glory to you..._

_Devotion to you..._

_Our light divine..._

_Of the first... the last..._

_We hear you!_

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin in front of the corpse in the Coral Tower for some lore.

_Remember our strength..._

_All to bow..._

_Now none to resist... But us..._

_Remember our rule..._

_All lost to fear..._

_Alone... against the pale light..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
In the secret area's room full of silk strands (which can be cut to disable Clawmaiden spawns), the Needolin can be played for lore.

_...Your silk..._

_...Ours by birth..._

_...Ours by right..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin in front of the corpse holding the Weaver Effigy for some lore.

_...I failed you..._

_...Too weak... to return..._

_...Your light..._

_...Forgive my silence..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin next to the body holding the Reaper crest for some lore.

_"...Sow and Reap..."_

_"...Praise their toil..."_

_"...Remember..."_

_"...Gather... For the many..."_

_"...Honor to the Reapers..."_

_"...Pharloom flourished..."_

**Note:** Will become inaccessible after leaving the area.

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for some lore.

_The bites... The stench..._

_... So dark..._

_...Trapped..._

_...All turned rotten..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin here for some lore.

_...Pharloom's fury..._

_...Pharloom's might..._

_...Endless heat..._

_...Ignite... Incinerate..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin inside the cell near the First Sinner before starting the fight for some lore.

_...First..._

_...Our Silk... ...Our rage..._

_...Faded..._

_...Wait, and hate..._

_...Wait, and die..._

_...Forgotten..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin near the Weaver monument for some lore.

_...Our Silk... Our memory..._

_...Through ages..._

_...Faded..._

_...Forgotten..._

_...Wait, and sleep..._

_...Wait, and die..._

_...For those who come after..._

title: Needolin Lore
description:
Play the Needolin beside the corpse that grants the Crest of the Beast for some lore.

_...Our foes..._

_...Our food..._

_...Life... Death... Nature..._

_...Remember..._
